sources.title: Gemini Omni — Unified Video, Image & Audio Model
sources.snippet: AI Video & Image Generator — Powered by Gemini Omni Gemini Omni is Google's native multimodal video generation model. Generate high-fidelity video from text or images, with synchronized audio and 1080p output.

sources.title: Gemini Omni
sources.snippet: Gemini Omni is Google's multimodal video generation and editing model released at Google I/O 2026. Unlike traditional AI video tools, Gemini Omni lets you create and edit videos through natural chat conversation — describe changes like "change the background to night" or "make the character dance" and Gemini Omni handles the rest.

sources.snippet: With fast multimodal generation, realistic image-to-video creation, and reliable voice consistency, our team can produce and test more high-performing campaigns at scale." sources.title: Gemini Omni — Google's AI Video Model with Native Audio
sources.snippet: Gemini Omni is Google's next-gen AI video model. Generate cinematic clips with native spatial audio and chat-based editing.
